newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Dollar climbs to new record high vs Tunisian dinar.
newsitem.headline: Dollar climbs to new record high vs Tunisian dinar.

text.p: The dollar climbed on Wednesday to its highest level against the Tunisian dinar since Tunisia's domestic forex market started in March 1994, dealers said.
Two hours after the opening, the dollar was trading at 1.0705 dinars on the interbank market, against 1.0558 dinars at Tuesday's close.
"The rise reflects the dollar's surge on the international market and not a weakeness of the dinar," Citibank-Tunis Treasury Director Ramz Hamzaoui told Reuters.
"Unliquid market might have contributed to the dollar's rise," Amen Bank dealing room chief Hatem Zaara said.
